title: exam_mode
description: 0.1.23+. Exam mode on or off. While it is on the PC reaches only the POps server, DNS/DHCP and the allow list (its own firewall rule group, independent of quarantine), the tray shows a banner that cannot be closed, and the listed apps are closed in user sessions. It ends at `until` even when the server cannot be reached, and survives a restart. A new command with `enabled: true` during an exam replaces its settings (the start time is kept). The agent answers every command with `exam_state`; with the `exam_enabled` capability off it also answers `capability_denied` (capability `exam`). Agents before 0.1.23 ignore it.

enabled.description: true starts exam mode (or changes a running one), false ends it. The Windows agent treats a missing or non-boolean value as false.

allow.description: Reachable besides the server, DNS and DHCP: host names (resolved again every 2 minutes and when a network address changes), IPv4/IPv6 addresses and CIDR ranges (at least /8 for IPv4, /16 for IPv6). One invalid entry refuses the whole command. Missing = only the server.

items.description: Host name, address or CIDR range; compared case-insensitively, a trailing dot is ignored.

until.description: End time, Unix seconds. Must be in the future, otherwise the command is refused. Missing = until `enabled: false`.

message.description: Text of the tray banner; control characters are removed and it is cut to 300 characters. Missing = "Sınav modu".

block_apps.description: Programs closed in user sessions every 2 seconds. Programs that would break the session or POps (explorer.exe, svchost.exe, winlogon.exe, the POps programs, ...) are skipped.

items.description: Executable file name only, for example cmd.exe; no path. An invalid name refuses the whole command.
